The Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact , officially the Treaty of Non-Aggression between Germany and the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics , [ 1 ] [ 2 ] [ c ] was a non-aggression pact between Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union , with a secret protocol establishing Soviet and German spheres of influence across Eastern Europe . [ 8 ] The pact was signed in Moscow on 24 August 1939 (backdated 23 August 1939 [ 9 ] [ 10 ] ) by Soviet Foreign Minister Vyacheslav Molotov and German Foreign Minister Joachim von Ribbentrop . [ 11 ]
